_meta.notes: Logical audio token assignments. Real audio files dropped into design/audio/ui/ and referenced by filename. Placeholder filenames — actual sound design happens with the freelance designer or in Phase 11.

principles: UI sounds are short (<300ms) and quiet — they accent action, never dominate.
Ambient loops are seamless (no perceptible loop point) and filtered (low-end heavy, no clear melodic content).
Voice fragments use the same NPC voice from in-game ElevenLabs Pro library.
Player can mute UI vs ambient vs voice independently in Settings.
